title: intercity_travel grouping keys (v0)
description: The coarse, shared keys that partition intercity travel demand and supply into the same matchable pool (docs/spec/01 §P3). Deliberately only three, all coarse — nothing rider- or driver-specific.

start_time_bucket.description: A coarse time bucket, not a precise instant — e.g. an ISO interval label. Precise timing is a constraint/preference, not a grouping key.
